path='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-fb366191.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    coords = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] != bg:
                coords.setdefault(g[r][c], []).append((r, c))
    # Each pair is a two-cell diagonal. Extend the line outward from the
    # endpoint facing away from the center of the colored arrangement.
    allpts = [p for ps in coords.values() for p in ps]
    cr = sum(r for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts)
    for color, ps in coords.items():
        if len(ps) != 2:
            continue
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = sorted(ps)
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        if abs(dr) != 1 or abs(dc) != 1:
            continue
        # Extend from the endpoint farther from the arrangement center.
        d1 = (r1-cr)**2 + (c1-cc)**2
        d2 = (r2-cr)**2 + (c2-cc)**2
        if d1 > d2:
            r, c, dr, dc = r1, c1, -dr, -dc
        else:
            r, c = r2, c2
        while 0 <= r+dr < h and 0 <= c+dc < w:
            r += dr
            c += dc
            g[r][c] = color
    return g
'''
